title: The prediction is the hollow run early
intention: The builder's pre-PROVEME prediction runs in the very environment the hollow measures in, because it is the hollow's own measurement run early over proofs named by hand, so a prediction can no longer be green where the hollow will refuse.
why: Peer F18 (2026-10-07): 11cd253f10bc's hollow refused ('no reversion reading can be attributed'; all 4 teeth failed at HEAD with "unknown node-class 'bug'") while the builder's pre-PROVEME prediction had been green, because the prediction ran beside a CairnCommons symlink sitting next to the scratchpad and the hollow's /tmp worktree has nothing beside it. The rule 'predict in a worktree with no commons sibling' is memory n=6 (hollow-worktree-has-no-commons-beside) and still failed: two constructions kept equal by hand. A prediction is what the builder leans on before crossing (Law 8), so it must be the hollow's own measurement.
traces_to: Law 8 (a prediction is the builder's evidence that the hollow will pass; a prediction run in another environment is a hollow green leaned on by the crossing) and Law 4 (predict-in-a-no-commons-worktree is a memory rule, hollow-worktree-has-no-commons-beside, n=6 — policy where the construction should be physics).
how: cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py: measure() gains proofs=None; when given, the instrument is instrument_set(proofs) instead of proven_by_since_buildme(), so the same worktree (and the same commons-beside rule) runs before any proven_by exists. cairn/devices/tester/cli.py: --proof PATH (repeatable) beside --hollow, refused with --seal (a seal lands only from the proofs the crossing named). The builder's hand-built no-commons worktree predict is replaced by `bin/cairn test --hollow <ticket> --proof <path>`. One new proof in cairn/devices/tester/proofs/.
falsifier: Falsifier: cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_prediction_is_the_hollow_run_early.py under PROVES {'fb47d26f7a43': {'1','2','3'}}: (1) a fixture ticket at BUILDME with a build commit and no proven_by: measure(t, proofs=[p]) returns measured {file: teeth} for the build file; (2) a fixture proof reading REPO.parent/'CairnCommons' with writes_to naming no commons file: measure(t, proofs=[p]) and measure(t) after proven_by names p give the same verdict and the same refusal text; (3) main(['--hollow', t, '--proof', p, '--seal']) returns non-zero, stderr names --seal, and the fixture's validations dir is unchanged. Hollow: revert cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py, teeth 1-2 red; revert cairn/devices/tester/cli.py, tooth 3 red. Horizon: the next voyage predicts with --proof and its hollow agrees with its prediction.

decisions.text: The proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_prediction_is_the_hollow_run_early.py is already on disk with PROVES {'fb47d26f7a43': {'1','2','3'}} and three teeth; measured red on today's code 2026-10-12: teeth 1-2 raise TypeError (measure() has no 'proofs' keyword) and tooth 3 gets argparse 'unrecognized arguments: --proof'. The builder does not edit the proof. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

In cairn/devices/tester/hollow.py, measure()'s signature (today ending 'berths_root=None, timeout: int = 120, tester=None, log=lambda _msg: None) -> dict:') gains a last keyword 'proofs: list[str] | None = None'. The line 'instrument = instrument_set(proven_by_since_buildme(tid, roots) or [], repo_root)' becomes: 'named = [_inside(str(p), repo_root) for p in proofs] if proofs else None' then 'instrument = instrument_set(named if named is not None else (proven_by_since_buildme(tid, roots) or []), repo_root)'. The later line 'proofs = proven_by(ticket, roots)' becomes 'proofs = named if named is not None else proven_by(ticket, roots)'. Nothing else in measure() changes: same worktree, same commons-beside rule (open-df8ce00ec559's answer, verbatim: 'the build as written; the commons stays beside the hollow only when writes_to names commons files'). The docstring gains a paragraph naming F18 and this ticket. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

In cairn/devices/tester/cli.py main(): add ap.add_argument('--proof', metavar='PATH', action='append', default=[], help=...) beside --hollow. In _hollow_run, before the 'try: finding = measure(...)' line: if args.proof and args.seal, print to stderr a sentence that names --seal (a prediction seals nothing; a hollow reading lands only from the proofs the crossing named) and return 2, before anything runs. The measure() call gains 'proofs=[str(Path(p).resolve()) for p in args.proof] or None'. The --exec refused-flag tuple list gains ('--proof', args.proof). After 'if args.hollow: return _hollow_run(args)', a bare --proof (no --hollow) prints a one-line stderr refusal and returns 2. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09

Run 'bin/cairn test cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_the_prediction_is_the_hollow_run_early.py' twice, both green; also run 'bin/cairn test cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_cli.py cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_hollow.py' green, because both modules are touched. CC's call, per Akien 2026-10-09
